relations: Sunlight through the glass jar produces shifting rainbow caustics within its cast shadow on the table.
The round dark blob at the shadow's end persists while colored refractions above it continuously reorganize.
A hand entering from the right casts a new double-edged diagonal shadow across the left-center table.
Slight camera drift reveals the dark front edge and a small screw hole at the bottom right.
caption:
A bright, sunlit speckled tabletop fills the view, with a clear glass jar resting at the top right. Inside the jar are pale spherical objects and a thin red stick whose apparent angle shifts slightly. The jar casts a long shadow toward the bottom center, a separate dark shadow lies at the top left, and the table's dark front edge runs along the lower left. Within the jar's shadow, shifting rainbow caustic patterns continuously reorganize, with red, yellow, blue, and purple bands appearing, moving, and fading.

The round dark blob at the lower end of the shadow stays in roughly the same position while the colored refractions above it keep changing. The camera drifts slightly, revealing a small dark screw hole at the bottom right and shifting the table's front edge. A hand enters from the right edge, and a new double-edged diagonal shadow stretches across the left-center of the table. A red and blue colored edge also appears along the top.
